method: Read every Japanese paragraph in sessions230–249, compare with both k/d source bodies across page breaks and inspect figures/captions. Enumerate bounded conceptual assertions and retain existing lesson/paragraph/translation objects. Prior primary claim files remain evidence with their original access limits; this register does not claim every linked external manual was freshly or fully reviewed. Original fictional p2 records are checked as applications of the explanation, not extra source facts.

sourceVisualReview.scope: Electric tool/drill-bit interface, saw/guide/collector/nailer/reel, shovel heads/rammer, ink-line/laser/punch photos and captions. No model, dimensions, calibration, operation or readiness inferred from photographs. Measuring section after punch is outside this batch. No numerical tables occur within the selected tool entries.

sourceObjectiveGap.objective: Vibration-based concrete compaction, unwanted entrapped air and density/fulfilment
